tableLines.line: ⛓️ Thornfield doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 50s, with a nervous tic speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
A woman, maybe 40s: "White Oak Acorns is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Hassan drew a tall weed with star-shaped leaves and spiny pods holding beautiful mottled beans in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Ella: "Wild Ramps is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
Renato: "Wild Strawberry is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
✨ Ability gained: Rally Aura (L1). People stand straighter near you. Allies who start a fight within 3 tiles of you start it emboldened (+4 damage for 2 rounds) and holding the line.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 13,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
Victor: "Mahua is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🗣️ Amit to Raj, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 13,500 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Nikolai's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
Martín wanders over, just to talk. "You hear what Amit said about the creek? ...Never mind. How are you holding up?"

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 13,500 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.
Amit: "Curry Leaf is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
